title: French Daily Challenges
delivery: one challenge per day; 5–10 minutes; no new grammar required

challenge_rules.streak_policy: award consistency points but never lock educational content behind a streak

challenges.title: Identity Ping
challenges.prompt: Say your name and ask another person’s name three times, changing the names.
challenges.target_pattern: Je m'appelle ____. Comment tu t'appelles ?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Vowel Radar
challenges.prompt: Record yourself saying a, e, i, o, u, then one word for each vowel.
challenges.target_pattern: a e i o u; merci, table, oui, deux, tu
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Origin Exchange
challenges.prompt: Answer where you are from and ask the question back.
challenges.target_pattern: Je viens de ____. D'où viens-tu ?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Article Hunt
challenges.prompt: Find or imagine five objects and label each with el, la, los, or las.
challenges.target_pattern: le livre; la table; les cartes; les maisons
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Human Snapshot
challenges.prompt: Describe one person with a noun and two agreeing adjectives.
challenges.target_pattern: C'est mon ami(e). Il/Elle est ____ et ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Question Chain
challenges.prompt: Ask qué, quién, dónde, and cómo questions about one scene.
challenges.target_pattern: Qu'est-ce que c'est ? Qui est-ce ? Où est-il/elle ? Comment va-t-il/elle ?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: First Contact
challenges.prompt: Complete a 45-second introduction without reading.
challenges.target_pattern: Bonjour. Je m'appelle ____. Je viens de ____. Enchanté(e).
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Room Scan
challenges.prompt: Describe three objects using hay, está, or están.
challenges.target_pattern: Il y a ____. Le/La ____ est ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Verb Sprint
challenges.prompt: Conjugate hablar, estudiar, and trabajar for yo, tú, and él/ella aloud.
challenges.target_pattern: parle/parles/parle; étudie/étudies/étudie; travaille/travailles/travaille
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: People Map
challenges.prompt: Describe three people using mi, tu, su, or nuestro/a.
challenges.target_pattern: Mon ____. Ton ____. Notre ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Yes/No Flip
challenges.prompt: Turn three positive sentences into questions and answer each positively and negatively.
challenges.target_pattern: Tu parles ? Oui, je parle. Non, je ne parle pas.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Preposition Walk
challenges.prompt: Describe where you are, where you go, and with whom.
challenges.target_pattern: Je suis à ____. Je vais à ____. Je vais avec ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Routine Relay
challenges.prompt: Give a four-step routine using primero, después, luego, finalmente.
challenges.target_pattern: D'abord ____. Ensuite ____. Puis ____. Enfin ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Daily Briefing
challenges.prompt: Give a 60-second report about home, routine, and one negative fact.
challenges.target_pattern: J'habite à ____. D'abord ____. Je ne ____ pas.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Café Recall
challenges.prompt: Order two items and reject one item politely.
challenges.target_pattern: Je voudrais ____, s'il vous plaît. Je ne veux pas ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Help Signal
challenges.prompt: Ask for help, then respond that you can or cannot help.
challenges.target_pattern: Peux-tu m'aider ? Oui, je peux. / Je ne peux pas encore.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Number Ladder
challenges.prompt: Count 1–30, then schedule two actions at different times.
challenges.target_pattern: J'étudie à ____. Je travaille à ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Market Mission
challenges.prompt: Point to two items, ask the price of one, and thank the seller.
challenges.target_pattern: Je voudrais ce/cette ____. Ça coûte combien ? Merci.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Preference Pulse
challenges.prompt: Say one singular preference, one plural preference, and one dislike.
challenges.target_pattern: J'aime ____. J'aime les ____. Je n'aime pas ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Needs and Wants
challenges.prompt: Combine quiero, necesito, and me gusta in one mini-dialogue.
challenges.target_pattern: Je veux ____. J'ai besoin de ____. J'aime ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Tomorrow Board
challenges.prompt: State three plans for tomorrow and ask someone else’s plan.
challenges.target_pattern: Demain, je vais ____. Qu'est-ce que tu vas faire ?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Map Route
challenges.prompt: Give a two-step route to a familiar place.
challenges.target_pattern: Continue tout droit et tourne à ____. C'est près.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Glue Words
challenges.prompt: Join four pairs of sentences using y, pero, porque, or también.
challenges.target_pattern: J'aime ____ parce que ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Irregular Five
challenges.prompt: Use soy, estoy, tengo, voy, and hago in five different sentences.
challenges.target_pattern: Je suis ____. Je suis ____. J'ai ____. Je vais ____. Je fais ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Turn-Taking
challenges.prompt: Answer a question, ask ¿Y tú?, and ask one follow-up.
challenges.target_pattern: Réponse. Et toi ? Qu'est-ce que tu aimes faire ?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Three-Pass Listening
challenges.prompt: Listen to a short French clip three times: situation, facts, useful phrase.
challenges.target_pattern: Situation: ____. Facts: ____. Phrase: ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Paraphrase Rescue
challenges.prompt: Explain one unknown object using cosa, para, and a known verb.
challenges.target_pattern: C'est une chose pour ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Final Voice Note
challenges.prompt: Record a 2–3 minute everyday French voice note using identity, routine, preference, plan, and repair.
challenges.target_pattern: Bonjour. Je m'appelle ____. Je viens de ____. J'aime ____. Demain je vais ____. Peux-tu répéter ?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.
